name: Coordinator decide(dev_from_task) → dispatch Amelia's bounded multi-turn dev loop
description:
The dispatch station (design R2, group 4). When a coordinator loop terminates with decide(action=dev_from_task) — the taxonomy token for 'develop the run's current task' — spawn the DEVELOPER loop (Amelia). The reshape makes this a BOUNDED MULTI-TURN loop, not a single forced author turn: Amelia gets a scoped tool allowlist (read_workspace, apply_patch, measure_task, ask_human) and tool_choice=auto, so she READS the checkout, authors the fix (apply_patch), MEASURES it in the warm sandbox (measure_task, her in-loop feedback), and ITERATES until she stops (success) or hits the component iteration cap (failed). apply_patch and measure_task no longer StopLoop — the loop continues on their results. Routing never trusts her stopping decision (G3): the floors trigger + route read the harness-stamped measurement.result regardless of loop outcome.

ATTEMPT ACCOUNTING (R3): on_enter appends task.attempt.instance = $entity.instance on the RUN (subject-override the coordinator loop's agent.run.entity-id) AT SPAWN TIME — object = the coordinator loop instance (distinct per dispatch). Appended at spawn (not terminal) so a crashed/wedged loop still consumed an attempt (honest accounting, restart-safe). The floors/review routes count DISTINCT objects of task.attempt.instance via length_* against the constant budget 3. This is the FIRST attempt; retries are appended by the floors-retry (06c) and review-retry (07b) routers, the other two sanctioned developer spawners.

RUN BINDING: run_scope=inherit reads the coordinator loop's agent.loop.run anchor (stamped on the run entity, dev-from-task/01) and binds Amelia's RunID to the same run, so read_workspace/apply_patch/measure_task resolve THIS run's checkout + warm sandbox. related_loops threads the run entity id so Amelia can query_entity the run to read the projected task.spec contract.

ROLE = developer (Amelia). SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps dev.developer.dispatched=$entity.instance on the coordinator loop (the firing entity), guarded by dev.developer.dispatched length_eq 0 — the house pattern (publish_agent is not idempotent; the decision fact stays on the loop, so without this a replay would re-spawn a duplicate developer). Marker stamped BEFORE the publish so a publish failure stalls-toward-human rather than duplicating. The RETRY re-dispatches are DISTINCT triggers (the floors/review routes on a failed attempt with budget remaining), not this rule re-firing.

CONTEXT-COMPLETE PROMPT (R7): the prompt threads the run entity id and instructs Amelia to read the full task contract (goal, target_files, test_command, assumptions, non_goals) via query_entity + read_workspace before authoring — entity-id-only prompts are gone. Rules cannot template cross-entity task.spec fields (a rule reads only the firing coordinator loop), so the read tools + a rich prompt are the whole context channel (audit-verified).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.developer
on_enter.prompt:
SEMDEV DEVELOPER (Amelia) — develop this run's current task.

Your run entity ID is $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id. FIRST read the immutable task contract with query_entity(entity_id="$entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id"): task.spec.goal, task.spec.target-files (the ONLY files you may touch), task.spec.test-command, task.spec.assumptions, task.spec.non-goals. Use read_workspace to read those files' current contents from the checkout. Then implement the change: author a unified diff (git format, a/ and b/ prefixes) touching only the declared target_files and record it with apply_patch. Then call measure_task(task_index=0) to run the frozen test command in the sandbox and read the real result. If it did not pass, revise and re-apply, then re-measure. When the test passes and you have nothing more to do, stop (do not call another tool). You author the intelligence; the harness measures the outcome and you never claim it (G3).

metadata.station: dispatch-developer — Amelia's bounded multi-turn dev loop (R2, group 4)
metadata.trigger_rationale: fires on the coordinator loop that decided dev_from_task (the decision lives on the loop). run_scope=inherit binds Amelia to the run so her tools target its checkout/sandbox.
metadata.multi_turn: tools allowlist [read_workspace, apply_patch, measure_task, ask_human] + tool_choice=auto make this a bounded multi-turn loop (R2): Amelia reads, patches, measures IN-LOOP (apply_patch/measure_task dropped StopLoop), and iterates. The in-loop cap is the agentic-loop component's max_iterations (uniform at M0; per-spawn is semstreams #528). Routing reads the harness-stamped measurement.result, never her stopping decision (G3).
metadata.attempt_counter: on_enter appends task.attempt.instance on the run AT SPAWN (R3): object=the coordinator loop instance, distinct per dispatch; the floors/review routes count DISTINCT objects via length_* vs the constant budget 3. Appended at spawn (not terminal) so a wedged loop still consumed an attempt.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped dev.developer.dispatched marker + length_eq 0 guard, stamped BEFORE the publish. Distinct from the retry re-dispatches (06c/07b), which are their own triggers.
metadata.serialization_invariant: this rule + the floors-retry route (06c) + the review-retry route (07b) + the transient-retry route (06f) are the ONLY sanctioned role=developer spawners — one developer loop in flight per task (pinned).
